summary.text: Ken Ivory is a Republican state representative from Utah House of Representatives District 39 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is an attorney who previously represented District 47 from 2011 to 2019.

paragraphs.text: Ken Ivory earned a B.A. in Japanese from Brigham Young University and a J.D. from California Western School of Law, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as an attorney.
Ivory served in the Utah House of Representatives for District 47 from 2011 to 2019.
In the 2023-2024 legislative term he chaired the House Health and Human Services Committee and served on the Transportation Committee.
